name: CAMELYON16
description: A challenge dataset of whole-slide images of lymph node sections for detecting breast cancer metastases, with expert annotations for tumor regions.
citation: Ehteshami Bejnordi, B., Veta, M., van Diest, P. J., et al. (2017). Diagnostic Assessment of Deep Learning Algorithms for Detection of Lymph Node Metastases in Women With Breast Cancer. JAMA, 318(22), 2199–2210. https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2017.14585
